story.vex: Rules only work if someone follows them. Your crew doesn't. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. No more shared logins, no more games on shield duty, no more open files. Astro: "A rule nobody follows isn't a rule. From today, the Citadel follows its own."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read policy\AUP.txt, Astro's three Citadel rules. Then find and fix every place the crew is breaking one:
1. A shared login nobody should still be using.
2. A program that has no business running on shield duty.
3. A file the whole crew can read that should be locked to Rivet only.
files.C:\\Citadel\\policy\\AUP.txt:
CITADEL ACCEPTABLE USE POLICY (Astro's three rules)
----------------------------------------------------
1. One account per crew member. No shared logins, ever.
2. Shield-duty consoles run shield software only. No games, no side projects.
3. Files marked CONFIDENTIAL are locked to the crew member who owns them.
files.C:\\Citadel\\engine-specs.txt: CONFIDENTIAL — Rivet's engine specifications. Anyone reading this should not be able to.

steps.title: Astro's three rules
steps.body: Astro: "Read the policy before you fix anything. Then find every place the crew is already breaking it." Start with `type policy\AUP.txt`.

steps.title: Find and fix every break
steps.body: Volt: "Three rules, three breaks. Fix them." Disable the shared login (`net user shift-shared /active:no`). Stop the game running on shield duty (`taskkill /im starcrawler.exe /f`). Lock the confidential file to Rivet (`icacls engine-specs.txt /deny cadet:F`, since everyone but Rivet should be denied).

objectives.label: engine-specs.txt is locked away from the crew
